question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Two peas in a pod

options.text: Look very similar in appearance or character

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom 'Two peas in a pod' means two people who are very similar, typically in interests, dispositions, or beliefs. The English meaning is two people who are very much alike (दो अत्यंत समान व्यक्ति).

 
 
• **Example:** My best friend and I are like two peas in a pod, we like all the same things.
 
 
 
• 'Look very similar in appearance or character', which is the correct answer, refers to a close resemblance between two people in terms of their looks or character. Its English meaning is to bear a close physical resemblance to someone (दिखन या चरित्र में बहुत समान होना).
 
 
• **Example: **The twins look so similar in appearance and character, they're like two peas in a pod.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• 'Make a bad situation worse' (Option 1) refers to doing something that exacerbates an already difficult scenario (बुरी स्थिति को और बदतर बनाना).
 
• 'Treat people fairly' (Option 2) means to deal with others in a way that is right or reasonable (लोगों को न्यायसंगत रूप से व्यवहार करना).
 
• 'Talk about a problem' (Option 4) refers to discussing an issue or difficulty (एक समस्या के बारे में बात करना).

56:Ta75,
The correct answer is **"Option 2".**
